runner.description: Declared test runner. The mesh maps this to a vetted command template; arbitrary shell strings are rejected at lease issuance.

path.description: Sandbox-scoped target — a directory, file, or single test id understood by the runner. Defaults to the workspace root.

filter.description: Runner-native filter expression (pytest -k, jest --testNamePattern, etc.). Validated against the runner's grammar before exec.

coverage.description: When true, runner is invoked with its standard coverage plugin and 'coverage' is populated in the output.

max_seconds.description: Hard wall-clock budget. Runner SIGTERMs the test process at this boundary and reports timed_out=true.

env.description: Whitelisted environment overrides (e.g. NODE_ENV, PYTHONHASHSEED). Keys not in the runner's allowlist are dropped with a warning.

failures.description: Per-failure detail. Truncated to 50 entries; remainder counted in 'failed'.

coverage.description: Populated only when coverage=true. Percentages are 0-100, line counts are absolute.

summary: Runs a project's declared test suite in an offline-network sandbox with a hard time budget; reports pass/fail and optional coverage.
notes: Network egress is disabled by default. Tests requiring outbound calls must request an explicit network scope on the lease and will trip the human-approval gate.
